EU.quote: 1. The placing on the market of jelly confectionery, including jelly mini-cups, containing E 425: Konjac: (i) Konjac gum (ii) Konjac glucomannane is suspended. 2. The use of E 425: Konjac: (i) Konjac gum (ii) Konjac glucomannane in jelly confectionery, including jelly mini-cups, is suspended.
EU.fact: The European Union suspended the market placement and use of E425 konjac in jelly confectionery, including jelly mini-cups.

US.reason: Small konjac powder jelly cups are under FDA import alert 33-15 and are not permitted for entry into the United States because small jelly cups containing konjac powder have previously been implicated in choking deaths of children.
US.quote: Small jelly cups containing konjac powder have previously been implicated in choking deaths of children. Small konjac powder jelly cups are presently under FDA import alert 33-15 and are not permitted for entry into the United States.
US.fact: Small konjac powder jelly cups are not permitted for entry into the United States because they have been implicated in choking deaths of children.
